reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles and nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium. A lab report is nice, but it tells me what's in the capsule, not whether I'll feel anything.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? A tested dose doesn't prove it does anything for me, and a money-back deal means I have to finish 30 days first.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, or a blood test showing I'm low.
